title: Set up environment: install Python packages (numpy, pillow) and system packages (ffmpeg, fonts-dejavu-core, curl)
Download BGM using tools/fetch_bgm.sh to audio/bgm.mp3
Run tools/analyze_audio.py to produce beat_map.json and AUDIO.md
Run tools/render_film.py to render the film at 1920x1080 30fps
Verify output with ffprobe (duration, fps, resolution, streams)
Generate poster frame from the video
Commit all generated artifacts to the repo
